Trait BigCurve

pub trait BigCurve<B>:
    Eq
    + Add
    + Sub
    + Neg

where
    B: BigNum
{
    // Required methods
    pub fn x(self) -> B;
    pub fn y(self) -> B;
    pub fn a() -> B;
    pub fn b() -> B;
    pub fn from_coordinates(x: B, y: B, is_infinity: bool) -> Self;
    pub fn point_at_infinity() -> Self;
    pub fn is_infinity(self) -> bool;
    pub fn one() -> Self;
    pub fn offset_generator() -> Self;
    pub fn offset_generator_final() -> Self;
    pub fn validate_on_curve(self);
    pub fn mul<let NScalarSlices: u32>(self, scalar: ScalarField<NScalarSlices>) -> Self;
    pub fn hash_to_curve<let N: u32>(seed: [u8; N]) -> Self;
    pub fn evaluate_linear_expression<let NScalarSlices: u32, let NMuls: u32, let NAdds: u32>(
        mul_points: [Self; NMuls],
        mul_scalars: [ScalarField<NScalarSlices>; NMuls],
        add_points: [Self; NAdds],
    ) -> Self;
}

Required methods

pub fn x(self) -> B

Returns the x-coordinate of the point.

pub fn y(self) -> B

Returns the y-coordinate of the point.

pub fn a() -> B

Returns the a-coordinate of the curve.

pub fn b() -> B

Returns the b-coordinate of the curve.

pub fn from_coordinates(x: B, y: B, is_infinity: bool) -> Self

Creates a point from its coordinates.

pub fn point_at_infinity() -> Self

Returns the point at infinity (the identity element of the curve group).

pub fn is_infinity(self) -> bool

Returns true if the point is the point at infinity.

pub fn one() -> Self

Returns the canonical generator point of the curve.

pub fn offset_generator() -> Self

Returns a generator point offset by a fixed value (implementation-specific).

pub fn offset_generator_final() -> Self

Returns the final offset generator point (implementation-specific).

pub fn validate_on_curve(self)

Validates that the point lies on the curve. May panic or fail if invalid.

pub fn mul<let NScalarSlices: u32>(self, scalar: ScalarField<NScalarSlices>) -> Self

Multiplies the point by a scalar value, returning the resulting point.

pub fn hash_to_curve<let N: u32>(seed: [u8; N]) -> Self

Hashes the provided seed to a point on the curve.

pub fn evaluate_linear_expression<let NScalarSlices: u32, let NMuls: u32, let NAdds: u32>( mul_points: [Self; NMuls], mul_scalars: [ScalarField<NScalarSlices>; NMuls], add_points: [Self; NAdds], ) -> Self

Evaluates a linear expression involving multiple points and scalars, returning the resulting point.
